## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix `select_failures` so it normalizes report paths before matching: right now any failure the runner reports with a `./` prefix is left out without warning, so those failed tests never get re-selected.

## Changes
The pull request adds `select_failures`, which picks requested paths from a runner report's `failed` list. It also rewrites `select_cached` and `_select_normalized` as list comprehensions without changing their behavior, and adds `tests/test_selection.py` covering all three selectors.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize report paths before matching requested set — A report with `{"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` and requested `{"tests/test_x.py"}` returns `[]`, because `path in requested` compares the raw spelling. `select_explicit` at `app/selection.py:6` handles the same spelling difference with `normalize(path) in requested`, and the new docstring's "preserving its original spelling" describes that pattern. `tests/test_selection.py:42-44` only uses unprefixed report paths, so no test catches this. — Runners that report `./`-prefixed paths have their failed tests silently left out of the re-run selection. — Fix: Use `[path for path in report["failed"] if normalize(path) in requested]` and add a `./`-prefixed case to `test_failure_report_selection`.
